metadata.description: Public extract of the AhaSlides design-system plugin: guidelines and paired judges for building product UI (Ant Design v6, settings/config UX, slide-type canvas + iframe, audience screen, typography, tables, overlays, paywall, feedback, status badges, shared primitives).

plugins.name: aha-design
plugins.description: AhaSlides design-system guidelines and PASS/FAIL judges for building and reviewing product UI. Public extract — internal-only skills (icon inventory, measured shared-component standard, user research) are excluded; brand tokens are AhaSlides' own and meant to be swapped for your brand.
